groups.rationale: ExactToken.pull is an internal exact-delta primitive, not an exposed arbitrary-victim debit endpoint. The new executor supplies only the fixed Vault; Entry uses msg.sender; ledger/converter paths use their authenticated caller/module. Authorization and exact before/after token deltas constrain each external caller. Actual token implementation and transfer behavior remain deployment qualification, not proved by this detector review.

Rewards._claim checks the current NFT owner or fixed claim-router forwarding, checkpoints, and clears personal/collective accrual and liability before paying the authorized recipient. External wrappers are nonReentrant and economic lifecycle guarded; the reported arbitrary ETH destination is the intended owner payment.

Royalty _claim authenticates current owner/router, synchronizes/checkpoints, clears accrual and liability/accounted backing before external payout. Its nonReentrant wrapper and final backing checks prevent a receiver callback from claiming the same accrual twice. Returned native currency is handled as a subsequent receipt.

FeeController._push is private. Its callers choose the fixed Rewards, Vault or Buyback module, not an arbitrary user recipient, and decrement/clear the classified reserve before transfer. Exact raw balance deltas detect a failed or unexpected transfer. This does not make arbitrary governance replacement code safe.

Converter is nonReentrant, live/operating, and callable only by its immutable ledger. It pulls an exact source amount, uses an admitted typed route and captured execution floor, resets approval and measures exact source/output native deltas. Native output goes to that ledger. Callback authorization and final raw balances were inspected; a malicious qualified venue/token or false admitted prices remain explicit external trust/qualification risks.

These private helpers run only through guarded Vault financial entrypoints. _balanceUsing spends bounded attributed amounts and checks exact returns; _receiveVenue accepts only the fixed Manager route and distinguishes actual received native credit from a raw ETH balance. Operation 0 allocates fees, 1 closes the complete portfolio, 2 closes only residual; a residual-only close does not clear the main LP ID. Post-callback accounting and idle backing are rechecked. canonicalWrite requires the fixed companion and inert canonical state, so it is not a token-reentry writer during normal operating calls.

Only fixed Vault calls guarded/sealed Manager.balance. Entrant tokens are pulled before the quote; exact budget/refund checks preserve prefunds. Captured context, policy, price bounds and final raw balances remain checked after callbacks; _swapExact is private and its unlock callback authenticates the fixed core and pending payload. It cannot be used as a public arbitrary router.

Executor is callable only by its fixed Manager, sealed/live and nonReentrant. It pulls exact native/fixed-token budgets, uses only typed PositionManager calls, resets Permit2 approval and authenticates main/residual ownership, key, ticks and liquidity after all refund callbacks. Ordinary replacement now verifies the main is actually active both before placement and after callbacks, including single-position mode. Residual association/count and final main floor are checked separately.

Activate/increase are economic/principal operating and nonReentrant entrypoints. Contribution identity/ownership is captured, incumbent fees are checkpointed and only entrant funds can meet marginal deployment floors. Exact added LP and post-operation aggregate NAV determine shares; accrued incumbent reward/compound cannot subsidize the entrant. Membership activation calls only fixed ledgers and rechecks operation invariants; callbacks cannot enter another guarded join or canonical writer.

Only keeper can execute a live nonReentrant buyback. Upper-bound input valuation caps spending, FeeController releases only its classified burn reserve, fixed/admitted route output is measured and ZZZ burning must reduce supply and restore expected balances. Final keeper/pause state is rechecked. It is not an arbitrary treasury transfer. Real token burn behavior and swap economics still need target qualification.

LP convertBatch is keeper/economic/nonReentrant guarded, checkpoints sorted unique bounded NFT IDs, clears exact old source balances/liability before conversion, measures the fixed converter deltas, resets approval and apportions output by cumulative floors to those same NFTs. Final keeper/pause checks remain. Conversion is not credited as new income.

Royalty convertBatch additionally synchronizes eligible currency receipts/accounted backing before clearing balances. NonReentrant lifecycle guard, bounded unique IDs, exact converter deltas and final keeper/pause/preparation checks preserve entitlement and prevent duplicate conversion. Healthy-currency and deferred-entry accounting remain independent.

Handoff fund/returnFunds are nonReentrant and phase/slot/root constrained. Approved peer, authenticated record amount/asset and exact destination/current balance deltas bind the transfer; funded/returned progress is recorded before the transfer. Restoration is only through fixed canonical modules under the abort phase. There is no arbitrary custody recipient.

Entry executeReviewed is live/economic/principal/nonReentrant. It verifies caller ownership, approved fixed contribution assets and route before pulling, captures pricing before callbacks and rechecks ownership after conversion/approval. Context is set immediately before the fixed Vault call and cleared immediately after. Source/output/native baselines and endEntry verify full exact execution; failure rolls back. No unrelated callback can borrow an active context for another join.

All reported private replacement/compound/movement helpers execute under the original Vault entrypoint nonReentrant and lifecycle/permission guards. Budget captures the source portfolio/value before callbacks and checks the post-close/swap/placement value and identity after them. Both-leg close, classified compound release, exact idle backing and operation completion checks remain. Move/resume call checkpoint(0) and therefore receive the same ordinary active-main guard. Terminal/paused-only routes retain their own authorization and exact pre/post checks; governance emergency intentionally permits explicitly selected financial bypasses and is a trust risk, not claimed safe against malicious governance.

New residual close is paused-governance through Migration with exact reviewed nonce, custody epoch, physical/control snapshot and raw minima; Vault accepts only the fixed Migration module and is nonReentrant. It harvests both legs, then closes only the registered associated residual into exact attributed Vault idle. Executor closeSecondary is fixed-parent/nonReentrant, validates the pair/main association and only clears secondary association/count after successful burn. Main identity/liquidity, shares, clock and configuration remain checked. Failure reverts every intermediate write/transfer.

Fixed Manager-only Executor collect/close is sealed/guarded/nonReentrant, authenticates Vault LP ownership and registered pair/secondary, submits fixed typed periphery actions with Vault recipient, validates exact returned balances and then updates associations. It is not a generic approval, recipient or arbitrary-action interface.

canonicalRestore is callable only by fixed Handoff in the permitted inert canonical/abort state. The released marker is written after the push, but Handoff nonReentrant plus canonical phase checks and the fixed recipient prevent an external payout callback from entering the authorized restore route again. Exact classified backing and released status are checked.

The division into complete units of 20 is intentional: each complete unit pays 16/2/1/1 for 80/10/5/5, with the remainder explicitly backed as dust. Join boundaries flush/checkpoint prior incumbent dust before eligibility changes. This rounding is not silently discarded or reassigned through arbitrary multiply-after-divide precision loss.

_floor truncates int24 division toward zero, then decrements for a negative nonmultiple, and multiplies by the validated positive tickSpacing. This intentionally constructs the mathematically lower aligned tick; subsequent range/TickMath bounds are checked.

Strict native equality is an intentional exact spend/prefund invariant. A callback returning/forcing extra ETH makes the transaction revert rather than being misclassified as allowed recipient output; this is not price equality.
actual==seen identifies no newly received royalty asset amount. actual<seen is rejected separately; it is not an exchange-rate comparison or an attacker-controlled exact-balance authorization.

Exact comparisons here are side/identity/timestamp sentinel and observation-state equivalence checks. They intentionally reset on disagreement, stale identity or missing observation and enforce sampled confirmation. They are not equality checks on a market price or raw funds.

Configuration is governance-only; calls go to the frozen typed ActivationAssets admission helper and oracle validation before applying reviewed fixed native/ZZZ pool controls. Helpers do not perform arbitrary token transfers/receiver callbacks. Parent/module identity and final contribution-pool configuration were inspected. A malicious authorized governance or admitted upstream dependency remains a deployment trust boundary.

Handoff settle/activate/importRows are nonReentrant and phase/root/progress constrained; external imports target fixed modules and are bounded by MAX_ROWS plus authenticated row/count/root checks. State writes after fixed module calls do not expose a receiver-selected reentrant phase advance. Both old retirement and new activation are atomically checked.

Only paused governance may close a snapshotted exit bucket. nonReentrant and Closing/notClosed/totalShares checks precede fixed Vault exit, exact native/ZZZ deltas and Exited status/shares are checked before recording closure, totals and epoch. No callback can re-enter closeBucket to consume the same snapshot.

allocatePrincipal is deliberately permissionless but nonReentrant/Allocating/bounded. It uses immutable mint order, current invariant share records and cumulative floors; each NFT is marked allocated and the full bucket sums are checked before Ready. refreshMetadata is fixed NFT ERC4906 event work, not a receiver callback. Nothing is paid from this function; current-owner payout is isolated later.

review.title: Canonical fixed module resolver and its seven loop callers
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: SLOTS=6; deploymentCommitment additionally reads exactly16 module IDs; export/import have MAX_ROWS=8. CompleteImport, activation and abort finalization visit6 domains. freeze has6 captures plus6 metadata reads and at most256 backing flags per domain; current six implementations expose at most116 total backing assets (Vault33, LP Rewards33, royalties17, fees33; NFT/Membership0).
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: All42 resolver records were checked against their displayed caller stacks: deploymentCommitment, freeze, exportRows, importRows, completeImport, activate and finishAbort. Resolver has no loop itself and uses view calls to the sealed Access registry/fixed Vault and NFT helpers. Fixed6 slots cannot grow through a callback. Nonreentrant coordinator entrypoints and canonical lifecycle locking surround mutable module calls; compatible replacement code is still explicitly trusted and reviewed.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded resolver fanout; lifecycle and row limits reviewed. Whole-domain transition gas and failure of an admitted backing asset remain qualification requirements, not eliminated by the6-slot bound.

review.title: Capture parked Vault buckets and backing currencies
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: groupCount comes from Vault permanent MAX_BUCKETS=4; reward assetCount is explicitly<=33 and Rewards admission/import also cap33. Backing duplicate scan totals at most528 comparisons. aliasCount and nftCount are captured lengths, not iterated by this function.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: First requires frozen state, a nonreentrant Vault barrier and zero registered residuals. All buckets must be empty or parked with no live main and no active plan. External get/group/asset/balance calls are view/static; neither bucket/asset lists nor backing classifications can be modified by a static callback. Recapture clears its captured caches and old flags rather than multiplying array length.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded and fail-closed; any failed ERC20 balance read or backing shortfall blocks capture. Full33-asset/4-bucket gas and failure recovery are not proven by static review.

review.title: Settle incumbent funded dust before membership entry
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: count<=Vault.MAX_BUCKETS=4 is checked. Two fixed current pair currencies per relevant bucket; after compositionEpoch!=0, admitted LP reward currencies explicitly<=33. At most33 unique currencies per bucket and132 flush calls across4 buckets, because the current pair is excluded from the historical-asset loop.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Only bound Vault invokes this economic operation. Snapshot bucket count cannot grow by outside reentry while its Vault contribution is nonreentrant. get/group/epoch/asset reads are static. Fee.flushDust is mutable and independently nonreentrant; it clears dust before credit, requires Vault/Membership and valid bucket status, and preserves canonicalAccounting pre/post checks. Rewards transfers are exact, liabilities updated and backed. A malicious admitted token could revert; it cannot select a new array or receive a sweep.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded incumbent settlement, not an unbounded per-NFT harvest. Funded broken-token dust can block entry atomically; zero dust returns before token handling. Qualify maximum historical-asset gas and exact token behavior.

review.title: Capture old-currency compound marks
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Only after compositionEpoch(bucket)!=0; admitted assetCount<=33. Current pair is skipped; _mark deduplicates, rejects a35th distinct mark (assets.length==34), and fresh Entry accepts only fixedETH/ZZZ.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Every dependency is read-only: Budget epoch, reward currency list, Fee compound balance and Oracle bounds. No pull/approval occurs in this loop. Only nonzero historical compound is marked; starting marks are never overwritten. The basis phase and Budget/Entry boundaries prevent an unrelated operation from adopting the captured vector.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded price collection; a required historical compound currency with unavailable prices can block contribution. That fails closed and does not make a guessed zero or finance entrant LP from incumbent reserves.

review.title: Settle fee dust at canonical cutoff
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Captured groups<=4, lpAssets in1..33, so at most132 canonicalFlush calls plus33 accounted/balance checks. The header capture and import validate those maxima.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Only fixed Handoff calls. Freeze has already fixed canonical state/cutoffs and blocked ordinary economic calls/configuration. Each dust remainder is cleared before credit to LP Rewards; frozen cutoff credit is explicitly allowed only during canonicalSettling and includes exact received backing. Any external failure reverts this whole domain settlement; coordinator advances its cursor only after success.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded mutable fanout with exact cutoff accounting; maximum132 nonzero dust credits and every admitted token must still be qualified for gas/liveness. No partial settlement is silently accepted.

review.title: Bind one importing successor to its frozen source
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Exactly6 slots, copying recordCount and assetCount only. No loop over NFT supply, assets or accounting rows here.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Requires IMPORTING, authenticated peer from immutable incomingSource, zero previous handoffId and matching source handoff/destination. Source count getters are static, not caller supplied. No external mutation in the loop; later completeImport and bounded row import verify counts, roots and exact source records.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded metadata copy; selected successor/source implementation remains a governance trust boundary.

review.title: Value old-currency compound reserves
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Composition epoch gates the scan; admitted assetCount explicitly<=33. It skips the current pair and values only nonzero reserve balances.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Read-only ledger and oracle calls. Inside the current contribution basis it uses the already captured lower mark for the same bucket; otherwise the Oracle supplies current reviewed value. Neither reward asset list nor reserves can mutate during static calls. No addition of raw liquidity across ranges.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded view work; required old-token oracle availability is intentionally fail-closed. It can make a quote unavailable, not silently zero.

review.title: Snapshot a terminal collective exit
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: bucketCount<=MAX_BUCKETS=4 explicitly checked; later mintedCount must be1..1000. The bucket loop does not iterate all NFT owners.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Governance-only, paused, sealed, operating, nonreentrant and exitPhase Operating only. Per-bucket static reads validate nonzero/empty shares and active/parked main identity and exact fixedETH/ZZZ pair before settlementBuckets.push. Calls Vault.beginLPExit only after validation, through a nonreentrant Vault barrier. Any failure rolls back appended state. Terminal Access lock prevents new mint/contribution after the snapshot.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded snapshot, one successful lifetime initialization. No price/swap dependency in this loop; all physical buckets must remain closeable through the separate close steps.

review.title: Snapshot NFT bucket/share state for checkpointing
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: In convertBatch, at most32 strictly increasing NFT IDs. Direct claim is oneNFT; checkpointOwner uses up to33 assets but snapshots bucket/share once before its internal-only per-asset loop.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Vault.nftBucket and sharesOf are static fixed-module reads. Checkpoint updates are per-ID/per-asset; equal collective eligibility and proportional owner shares remain separate. No external mutable call can change shares inside the iteration.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded read fanout; no whole1000NFT settlement requirement. Required Vault/read availability remains a dependency.

review.title: Import exact frozen accounting rows in bounded chunks
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: records.length in1..8 and cursor+length<=recordCount[slot]. Fixed6 slot selector. Ordinary accounting/alias/NFT rows have fixed fields; NFT header includes the immutable pre-seal artworkBaseURI, whose validator restricts scheme but not byte length. Lifetime aliases are processed in8-row chunks rather than one whole-list loop.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Nonreentrant IMPORTING state; source must be EXPORTING with nonzero committed root and same handoffId. Every supplied row hash is compared with sourceModule.canonicalExport at exact ordinal before typed destination import; import cursor increments roll back on any failure. NFT import writes raw ownership without ERC721 receiver callbacks. All ordinary economic activity stays locked.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded iteration, never arbitrary operator accounting rows. A large governance-selected header URI can increase one-row byte/memory/gas cost; actual immutable URI and worst current batch payload must be qualified. Source availability and trusted reviewed replacement behavior still require rehearsal.

review.title: Owner-authenticated LP/royalty claim batching
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: 1..32 claim tuples. Duplicate nested scan at most496 comparisons, with at most32 payout calls.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Router is nonreentrant and has fixed NFT/royalty destinations. Full owner/duplicate preflight precedes any payout; the second loop repeats current-owner check and each ledger repeats it again. A prior ETH/token payout callback transferring an NFT cannot redirect a later old-owner claim. Ledgers pay the authenticated current owner directly, never router-selected recipient. Any failure rolls the whole batch back.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded atomic claim batch; a failing selected asset/receiver may reject the whole batch. Users may split/omit failing tuples. No universal worst-case payout gas guarantee.

review.title: Native/ERC20 backing observation in inherited bounded callers
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: LP Rewards assets<=33; royalty assets<=17. Royalty activate and syncAll visit<=17; canonical capture/validate/activate visit that ledger limit. CanonicalAdd duplicate checks visit<=33 or17 prior entries. No NFT-supply iteration in this balance helper.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Each balanceOf is static. Royalty activation isolates every optional ERC20 synchronization with a250000gas self-call and120000-tail requirement, preserves old eligible cohort and defers failed currencies; native synchronization has no token call. syncAll and canonical capture/validate/activate deliberately fail atomically if one required currency cannot report backing; per-asset sync remains independently callable. NFT/asset enrollment and ordinary ledger mutation are lifecycle locked during canonical transitions.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Context-specific bounded reads, not globally a harmless false positive. Optional activation faults are isolated; syncAll/canonical availability and max-currency gas remain open dependency/operating qualification.

review.title: Convert selected NFTs funded LP rewards into ETH
review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: 1..32 strictly ascending IDs. Two bounded passes over those same IDs; no supply-wide scan.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Keeper/live/operating/nonreentrant/economic gates. Owner existence and indices checkpoint before clearing whole-unit selected balances; token and native exact deltas verified around one bound converter call. Source liability decreases and native liability increases once. Cumulative output rounding allocates every output wei to those same IDs/components; conversion does not reallocate by current membership or create new income. Final keeper/pause checks detect callback permission changes.
review.remaining_risk_or_qualification: Bounded conversion and exact conservation; token/router/oracle availability and max32 economically useful gas require qualification. Failures revert selections and converter transfers atomically.

review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Deduplicated marks capped34 by _mark; current fresh pair/input isETH/ZZZ, historical admitted LP assets<=33. Clear removes all marks before another operation.

review.actual_bound_and_lifetime_domain: Exactly6 domains; backing-flag loop <=256 per domain by freeze, current modules<=116 total. Each module validation has its own33/17currency and4bucket bounds; no all-NFT import occurs here.
review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Only authenticated source in RETIRED phase can activate matching IMPORTED_AWAITING_BACKING destination. Checks all funding flags and every typed canonicalValidate before any canonicalActivate, then moves Access to OPERATING. Coordinator nonreentrant; economic lifecycle frozen throughout callbacks. review.call_and_mutation_reasoning: Nonreentrant IMPORTING only. Source export roots and module counts are static, trusted-source-bound reads. Compares aggregate stateRoot and source phase before progressing. No ordinary destination activity is possible before later funded activation.

review.rationale: Private companion transfer is reachable only through fixed-Handoff canonical release/return/accept flow, with once-only released/accepted flags and exact captured backing/prefund classification. supplement_review.rationale: Royalty.activate checks remaining gas before each optional-currency self-call, passes ABI-encoded fixed syncForActivation calldata with fixed ACTIVATION_SYNC_GAS, copies no returndata and uses only the success bit. data is an allocated bytes buffer; add(data,32)/mload(data) refer to its exact payload. supplement_review.description: The function ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.observe(uint256) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#192-213) reads (side,identity,manual) = this.condition(bucket) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#193-212) with `this` which adds an extra STATICCALL.
supplement_review.rationale: The explicit this.condition STATICCALL is required for Solidity try/catch: any fresh oracle/pool/identity read fault must clear observations and emit ObservationReset in a successful transaction. A direct internal call would bubble the revert and undo deletion, restoring stale evidence. Its extra STATICCALL is intentional fault isolation, not an unused convenience call.
